data.acceptance:
1. Bridge mode imports new legacy events into v2 and reverse-exports accepted v2 events so old clients remain correct before freeze, deduplicating by exact event ID and content hash.
2. Cutover installs and probes legacy update/recreation denial before capturing the final legacy SHA, draining through that SHA, and activating v2.
3. Activation requires zero bridge backlog, projection-complete full-replay equivalence, immutable archives, protected canonical refs, and fresh-clone read/write proof.
4. Offline legacy work remains local; after upgrade it enters an inbox and stale mutations are durably quarantined rather than discarded.
5. Per-repository rollout states are resumable and rollback creates a newer recovery generation without reopening legacy or deleting archives.
